why: a numbered list of single characters is a character lesson, not a calendar
note: The round-2e calendar rule fired on any single-character run with digits glued to its front on a list, so 日 became "the 1st" and 月 became "February" while 水 火 木 stayed correct: half the game wrong, which reads as random rather than as one broken rule. 日月水火木 is the first set of characters a class learns and numbering it with no separator is how a teacher types one. The rule now reads the WHOLE PASTE: calendar cards only when every digit-fronted single-character run in it is a calendar unit, which keeps fixture 48 and kills this.
